Added pronunciation template. An IPA template is often helpful, as, when you think about it, there's three parts in his last name that you could assume are pronounced differently. (1.) the "u" sound (it's the "u" sound in "gut", but one could think it's like "u" sound in "true"), (2.) the "-ford" (it's unstressed, but one could think it's stressed), and (3.) the "th" sound (it's the "th" sound in "moTHer", but one could think it's the "th" sound in "boTH").
